headline: RiotUSA: Short attention spans reshaping hip-hop production
body: RiotUSA claims today’s short attention spans are changing how artists craft music, explaining why producers now rush to the hook. Speaking on Power 105 with Art (@ThaBoyArt), the artist discussed the shift in hip-hop creation habits. 'Y’all agree?' he asked, prompting immediate engagement from listeners.

caption:
RiotUSA’s insights on modern music production trends highlight a growing concern among artists about audience retention. The interview underscores how digital age distractions are impacting creative processes. Fans speculate if this trend will lead to more experimental or formulaic music.
